jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Manager
jobs.description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Turn concepts into delivery-ready work
  + Partner with product, clinical, operational, and engineering stakeholders to understand business problems, functional needs, users, workflows, and intended outcomes
  + Translate concepts into clear features, user stories, workflows, acceptance criteria, assumptions, dependencies, and success measures
  + Seek clarity when needs are incomplete or conflicting rather than allowing assumptions to become requirements
  + Produce high-quality, usable features in partnership with engineering teams and refine them until they are ready for execution
* Create execution visibility and control
  + Maintain a clear view of each major deliverable, its owner, current status, progress, dependencies, barriers, and required decisions
  + Plan and facilitate meetings with a clear purpose and agenda; document decisions, owners, and next actions
  + Proactively communicate status, scope changes, risks, dependencies, and delivery impacts
  + Escalate risks early enough for stakeholders to resolve barriers or make informed tradeoffs before commitments shift
* Lead cross-functional collaboration
  + Build rapport and trusted working relationships with clinical experts, operations stakeholders, product partners, and engineering teams
  + Listen carefully, ask thoughtful follow-up questions, and ensure expert knowledge is understood, documented, retained, and applied to future work
  + Influence without direct authority and help stakeholders reach clarity on priorities, requirements, tradeoffs, and ownership
  + Coordinate initiatives that cross sprint boundaries or require alignment across multiple teams
* Advance healthcare workflow modernization
  + Develop an increasingly solid understanding of healthcare workflows, systems, data considerations, and operational constraints
  + Explore not only what needs to be built, but why it matters and how the workflow could be improved
  + Identify opportunities to apply technology, automation, interoperability, and AI to improve healthcare processes and outcomes
  + Keep healthcare privacy, data protection, regulatory, and governance considerations visible throughout product discovery and delivery
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field
* 5+ years of experience in product management, product ownership, business analysis, technology consulting, solution design, software delivery, or related disciplines supporting software-enabled products
* 3+ years of experience gathering, documenting, and managing business requirements, user stories, workflows, process maps, acceptance criteria, and delivery-ready product artifacts
* 3+ years of experience leading cross-functional initiatives involving business, operational, and technical stakeholders
* 3+ years of experience working within Agile software development environments such as Scrum, SAFe, Kanban, or similar frameworks
* Demonstrated experience translating complex or ambiguous business needs into clear, actionable requirements and product deliverables
* Demonstrated experience facilitating stakeholder discussions, driving alignment, documenting decisions, and managing competing priorities
* Proven experience identifying, communicating, and escalating risks, dependencies, scope changes, and delivery challenges
* Working knowledge of software development processes and technology concepts sufficient to collaborate effectively with engineering teams and ask informed technical questions
* Proven exceptional written, verbal, presentation, and meeting facilitation skills
* Demonstrated ability to organize multiple concurrent initiatives, deliverables, dependencies, and stakeholder groups
* Demonstrated ability to influence without direct authority and build trusted relationships across product, operations, and technology teams
* Demonstrated learning agility and ability to quickly understand and retain knowledge about complex business domains

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

jobs.title: Manager Data Products & AI Analytics - Supply Chain Operations - BPR
jobs.description:
Summary
  
  
At Apple, we rely on our employees diverse set of backgrounds and perspectives to champion innovation through extraordinary ideas to surprise and delight our customers. These ideas can come from anywhere. Will that next phenomenal idea come from you? Do you want to help build some of the largest and most consequential enterprise and customer technology systems in the world? Join Apple’s Information Systems and Technology (IS&T) organization. IS&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. It’s Apple’s central nervous system. Supporting 2.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly, IS&T makes the impossible feel effortless.” Do you love building solutions to handle global complexity and immense scale? Imagine what you could do here.
  
  
Description
  
  
Our BPR team is looking for a Manager – Data Products & AI Analytics to lead a team that turns Apple's supply chain data into trusted, AI-ready analytics. You will combine deep supply chain functional credibility with technical judgment. You will build and grow a team, set its direction, and make sure it delivers decisions, not just dashboards, across Planning, Operations, Logistics, Manufacturing, and Fulfillment. This is a highly visible role. You will be the primary link between business leaders, technology partners, and an analytics team that may span multiple locations.
  
  
Minimum Qualifications  
  
  

* 12+ years across supply chain operations, data products and analytics or AI, including 3–5 years managing teams.
* Hands-on knowledge of at least one area: demand/supply planning, materials, inventory optimization, procurement or logistics.
* Experience with data products, data governance and quality monitoring.
* Experience building semantic layers or self-service analytics platforms.
* Working knowledge of a modern data stack (for example Snowflake, BigQuery or Databricks, dbt, Airflow).
* Understanding of the ML lifecycle and GenAI concepts (LLMs, RAG, agents).
* Strong SQL and data modeling.
* Experience in a global, matrixed organization.
* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

  
  
  
Preferred Qualifications  
  
  

* Experinece in supply chain product development
* Master's degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Operations Research, Computer Science or Analytics, or equivalent experience.

  
  
  

At Apple, we believe accessibility is a fundamental human right. You’ll find that idea reflected in everything here — in our culture, our benefits and our digital tools. By welcoming as many perspectives as possible, we help you build a career where you feel like you belong.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
* Full-time

**Company Description**
-----------------------

AbhiBus is a leading online bus-ticketing platform that aggregates ticket inventory from over 4,000 bus operators - including major State Road Transport Corporations (SRTCs), covering more than 3.5 lakh (350,000+) routes across India. The AbhiBus website and apps allow users to check amenities provided by bus operators, compare booking fares, check bus timings in the searched route, live tracking of the bus before arrival, cancellation protection options and other facilities. It is the official ticketing partner for several state road transport corporation bus tickets and IRCTC bus bookings.

AbhiBus is owned and operated by ixigo (Le Travenues Technology Limited), India’s leading OTA for the Next Billion Users. With over 54 crore Annual Active Users in FY25, ixigo offers AI-powered train, flight, bus, and hotel bookings through its platforms - ixigo, ConfirmTkt, and AbhiBus.

**Job Description**
-------------------

You’ll own one or more parts of the traveller journey across app and web; we’ll set the exact charter with you. Work on our roadmap includes:

Search and booking — comparing buses, smarter filters, a cleaner seat layout and fewer payment drop-offs.

The trip — an AI-powered Trip Mode, live tracking, delay alerts and boarding-point guidance.

Cancellations and refunds — alternatives before a cancel, clear refund tracking and easy reschedules.

Growth and monetisation — rewards and referrals, cross-sell and upsell, and supply-side monetisation through operator ads and sponsored listings.

**What you’ll do**

Own outcomes — set the roadmap and KPIs for your area, and own the results.

Find the real problem — talk to travellers, bus operators, sales and on-ground teams and support, and keep asking why until you reach the root cause.

Design the experience — sketch and prototype, and work with designers to craft “aha” moments and delightful nudges.

Build with AI — prototype faster, and turn manual, support-heavy journeys into self-serve ones.

Let data decide — pull your own data, run A/B tests and challenge assumptions.

Ship end to end — write clear specs, launch smoothly, keep improving, and keep engineering, design and business aligned.

**What success looks like**

Measurable gains in your metrics — conversion, repeat bookings, app ratings, fewer support contacts.

Superlative experiences, with clear “aha” moments and delightful nudges that travellers notice.

At least one manual journey made self-serve with AI.

**Who you are**

A PM who thinks like a designer and notices friction others miss.

Deeply empathetic — you feel the traveller’s worries before you design for them.

A design thinker who frames the problem before jumping to a solution, and tests early with real users.

Comfortable with data and AI tools, a clear communicator, and high on ownership.

**Qualifications**
------------------

2–4 years of product management experience on customer-facing (B2C) app or web products.

A track record of shipping features end to end and moving a metric you can name.

Hands-on SQL and analytics — funnels, cohorts, A/B tests (tools like Mixpanel, CleverTap, GA or similar).

Practical use of AI tools in product work — e.g. ChatGPT or Claude for research and specs, and Figma AI, Lovable, Cursor or similar for prototyping.

Hands-on with design thinking and user research — interviews, usability tests, journey mapping — and able to create wireframes and clickable prototypes in Figma or similar tools.

Clear written and verbal communication.

**Strongly preferred**

A UX, UI or product design background. Please include a portfolio if you have one.

An MBA from a reputed business school.

**Good to have**

Experience in travel, mobility, e-commerce, payments or marketplaces.

Experience with conversational AI, offers or loyalty products.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager - Platform UI, Officer
jobs.description:
**Charles River Development | Platform UI Framework**

**Who We’re Looking For**

* We are seeking an Associate Technical Product Manager to lead roadmap execution for foundational user interface capabilities within the Charles River and Alpha Platforms.
* This role is ideal for a technically minded product professional with 9+ years of experience across product management, business analysis, quality assurance, software development, UX, or related technology disciplines who is curious, hands-on, and comfortable using modern tools to solve problems independently. We are looking for someone fluent in generative AI tools, modern web technologies, APIs, data, and user experience, and who naturally looks for faster and better ways to get work done.
* You do not need to be a software engineer, but you should be comfortable working with technology directly. For example, rather than defaulting to a PowerPoint presentation, you might use AI-assisted tools to quickly create a more compelling interactive presentation. Rather than requesting a new report, you might use an available API and tools such as VS Code and GitHub Copilot to prototype a simple web application that answers the question.
* Rather than manually analyzing a large set of product feedback, you might use an LLM to help identify themes and then validate the results yourself.

jobs.title: Product/Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Role Summary**

The Product/Project Manager drives the program from MVP to GA. You own the backlog and plan, keep a cross-functional technical team aligned on milestones, manage risks and dependencies, and provide clear delivery reporting to ComTek-side stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product**

* **Backlog:** Own the product backlog and prioritise by customer value, risk and GA scope using the story map and technical dependency analysis with the Tech Architect.

* **GA definition:** Define the GA scope, exit criteria and readiness checklist (security, performance, billing, migration, support).

* **Beta:** Run the beta programme and feedback loop with the Business Analyst.

**Delivery**

* **Cadence:** Run sprint planning, reviews and retrospectives; track velocity and DORA metrics (deployment frequency, lead time, change failure rate, time to restore).

* **Plan:** Maintain milestones and the critical path across ingestion, AI/ML, billing, identity, security and migration workstreams; manage cross-team dependencies and environment/GPU capacity needs.

* **Risk:** Maintain RAID log; escalate and mitigate technical and schedule risks with workstream leads.

**Stakeholders and Migration**

* **Reporting:** Provide weekly status, burn-up, risk and budget reports to ComTek-side stakeholders.

* **Migration:** Coordinate MVP customer migration planning, communications, cutover windows and support readiness.

* **Change control:** Manage scope changes and decision records with the Tech Architect.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* 7+ years in product or project management with SaaS experience.

* Agile delivery at scale; Jira or similar.

* Experience managing technically complex programmes involving cloud, data and AI.

* Strong stakeholder communication and reporting.

**Preferred / Added Advantage**

* Experience with multi-tenant SaaS, billing or data/AI products.

* Customer migration programmes.

* PMP, CSM, SAFe or similar certification.

**Key Deliverables**

* Program plan, roadmap and milestone tracker.

* Weekly delivery reports; RAID log.

* GA readiness checklist and cutover plan.

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business or equivalent; MBA a plus.

jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst
jobs.description:
**Experience**

5+ years

**Primary focus**

User stories and acceptance criteria, story map, beta feedback triage

**Technology stack**

Jira/Confluence, Gherkin (Given/When/Then), BPMN/draw.io, Postman (API reading), basic SQL/MongoDB queries, OpenAPI

**Role Summary**

The Business Analyst translates program goals into clear, testable requirements for a technical SaaS product. You keep the story map and acceptance criteria current and, during beta, turn customer feedback into prioritised backlog items. This is a part-time role with allocation rising during beta.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Requirements**

* **Stories:** Write user stories with Gherkin acceptance criteria covering functional behaviour, error cases, tenancy/role constraints and non-functional targets agreed with the Tech Architect.

* **Story map:** Build and maintain the GA story map and release slices.

* **Domain flows:** Document and map processes: tenant onboarding, SSO setup, subscription and billing changes, media upload and processing, result review, export, offboarding.

**Technical Collaboration**

* **Data and API:** Read OpenAPI specs and data models to validate requirements; define data mapping rules for MVP migration with the Drone Data Architect.

* **Traceability:** Maintain traceability from requirement to test case to release; support UAT planning with QA.

**Beta Feedback**

* **Triage:** Capture, categorise and quantify beta feedback; separate defects, usability issues and feature requests; recommend priorities to the product manager.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* 4+ years as a business analyst.

* Requirements analysis, user story and acceptance-criteria writing.

* Process modelling (BPMN or flow diagrams).

* Comfort reading APIs and data models; basic SQL.

* Jira/Confluence.

**Preferred / Added Advantage**

* SaaS, subscription or multi-tenant product experience.

* Geospatial, drone or AI product exposure.

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Are you passionate about building innovative, customer facing analytics products that help businesses make smarter purchasing decisions? Do you enjoy solving complex customer problems at scale using data, analytics, and artificial intelligence? Are you excited about shaping how organizations of all sizes understand, manage, and optimize their business spending?  
  
Amazon Business is transforming how businesses, governments, and organizations purchase products and manage procurement operations. Serving millions of business customers worldwide, Amazon Business combines the selection, convenience, and value of Amazon with capabilities tailored to the unique needs of business customers.  
  
Amazon Business Analytics (ABA) plays a critical role in this transformation by building a suite of customer facing analytics products that help organizations turn purchasing data into actionable insights. Our customers range from small and medium businesses to large enterprises and public sector organizations. Our products empower procurement leaders, finance teams, and business administrators to understand organizational spending, identify savings opportunities, monitor purchasing behavior, and make informed business decisions.  
  
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager, Technical (PMT) to help shape and deliver the next generation of Amazon Business Analytics experiences. In this role, you will drive product strategy and execution across our customer facing analytics portfolio, spanning spend visibility, self service reporting, intelligent insights, and AI powered conversational analytics. You will build intuitive and scalable products for the full range of business customers, from those seeking simple, out of the box spending insights to large enterprises requiring sophisticated analytics across complex organizational structures.  
  
You will have the opportunity to reimagine how business customers interact with their purchasing data, moving beyond traditional dashboards and reports toward intelligent, proactive, and conversational experiences. You will use advances in generative AI, large language models, and modern data technologies to make analytics more accessible, personalized, and actionable for customers worldwide.  
  
This is a highly visible role that requires strong customer obsession, technical judgment, strategic thinking, and the ability to influence and deliver across multiple engineering and business organizations. The ideal candidate thrives in ambiguity, dives deep into customer and technical challenges, and has a demonstrated track record of building and scaling customer facing technology products.  
  
We are open to hiring candidates to work from the following locations: Hyderabad, IND | Bangalore, IND  
  
Key job responsibilities  
As the PMT for ABA, you will own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for customer facing analytics capabilities across Amazon Business. You will develop a deep understanding of how small businesses, large enterprises, procurement professionals, and finance teams use purchasing data, and turn those needs into intuitive, scalable, and differentiated product experiences.  
  
You will lead the development of intelligent analytics experiences, including conversational interfaces, natural language querying, proactive insights, and AI powered capabilities. You will also build products that help customers analyze organizational spending, identify savings opportunities, and improve procurement outcomes. You will balance ease of use for smaller businesses with the depth that large enterprises require, and develop capabilities that serve customers across multiple geographies.  
  
You will partner closely with engineering, applied science, UX, and data teams to define product requirements, evaluate architectural tradeoffs, and deliver scalable, reliable analytics solutions. You will define success metrics and use customer feedback, experimentation, and data to keep improving outcomes. Finally, you will collaborate with senior leaders across Amazon Business to align priorities and drive decisions.

* Bachelor's degree
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
* Experience managing technical products or online services
* Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools
* Experience in using analytical tools, such as Tableau, Qlikview, QuickSight
* Experience in an operational environment developing, fast-prototyping, piloting and launching analytic products

jobs.title: Lead Business Analyst - AI Framework
jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly analytical and strategically minded **Product Owner (PO) for AI & Agentic Products** to drive the vision, strategy, and execution of our AI-driven product portfolio. In this role, you will be the bridge between commercial stakeholders and our advanced AI engineering team.

You must possess a deep understanding of business domains alongside a strong technical grounding in Artificial Intelligence, Large Language Models (LLMs), and autonomous agent workflows. Working closely with our AI Development Lead, you will translate high-level business requirements into granular user stories, actively participate in building Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), and ensure the engineering team is building AI solutions that deliver measurable business impact.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with business leaders, domain experts, and end-users to discover, define, and document comprehensive business requirements
* Evaluate business problems through an AI lens — determining whether a problem is best solved via deterministic software, traditional ML, or generative AI/agentic workflows
* Define, maintain, and communicate the product roadmap, balancing short-term business wins with long-term technical architecture sustainability
* Partner with the AI Development Lead to deconstruct high-level product features into comprehensive Work Breakdown Structures (WBS)
* Write highly descriptive, value-driven Epics and User Stories. Define clear Acceptance Criteria that account for the non-deterministic nature of AI outputs
* Own, groom, and prioritize the product backlog based on ROI, user impact, and technical dependencies defined by the engineering lead
* Translate complex business rules and industry domain knowledge into logic that AI engineers can use to build agent prompts, tools, and cognitive routing
* Work with the engineering team to define "what success looks like" for AI agents, helping establish performance benchmarks, evaluation datasets, and user feedback loops
* Actively participate in daily standups, sprint planning, and sprint reviews, acting as the ultimate voice of the customer

**Requirements**

* Solid conceptual understanding of Generative AI, LLM capabilities (e.g., Google Gemini ecosystem), RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), function calling, and multi-agent orchestration. You don't need to code it, but you must know how it works
* Proven ability to map business processes, identify operational bottlenecks, and quantify the return on investment (ROI) of automation features
* Comfort with managing product lifecycles for non-deterministic software (where AI outputs are not always 100% predictable)
* Extensive experience working as a Product Owner in Scrum or Kanban environments, using tools like Jira, Confluence, or Azure DevOps
* Proven track record of breaking down complex enterprise requirements into logical, incremental software delivery phases (MVP approach)
* Exceptional ability to explain technical AI constraints to business users and business nuances to technical engineers

**Nice to have**

* Prior experience acting as a Product Owner or Product Manager for data science, machine learning, or generative AI products
* Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or Professional Scrum Product Owner (PSPO) designation
* Background in Business Analysis or Systems Analysis with a later specialization in AI/ML products

jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst
jobs.company: DOWC Technologies pvt ltd - Fortis India
jobs.description:
Position - Senior Data Analyst

Location - Madhapur, Hyderabad

Experience - 5+ years

**Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Data Analyst who combines strong analytical skills with **hands-on experience building reports and dashboards directly in Omni**.

In this role, you will work closely with US leadership and cross-functional teams to understand business requirements, develop reliable reporting, and turn complex data into useful business insights. You will take ownership of analytical deliverables, from defining requirements and understanding source data to developing, validating, and maintaining reports.

The ideal candidate is comfortable investigating data independently, questioning inconsistencies, and understanding the business logic behind each metric. You should be able to explain what the data shows, why it matters, and how it supports business decisions.

**Direct report development experience in Omni is essential. Experience in other BI tools is valuable but does not replace this requirement.**

**Key Responsibilities**

Omni Reporting and Dashboard Development

* Build, maintain, and enhance reports and dashboards directly in Omni for business, operational, and management reporting.
* Translate stakeholder requirements into clear metrics, reporting logic, and intuitive visualizations.
* Develop reports that allow users to explore relevant trends, investigate exceptions, and monitor performance.
* Review and improve existing reporting for accuracy, usability, consistency, and performance.

Data Analysis and Business Understanding

* Write and optimize SQL queries to retrieve, combine, and analyze data from multiple datasets.
* Develop a thorough understanding of product workflows, business processes, and the relationships between source data and reported results.
* Identify trends, anomalies, and performance gaps, and communicate findings with relevant business context.
* Work with stakeholders to clarify ambiguous requirements and agree on consistent definitions for KPIs and business metrics.

Data Quality and Collaboration

* Validate reports against underlying datasets and business rules before release.
* Investigate discrepancies, identify root causes, and coordinate with data engineering and product teams to resolve issues.
* Collaborate with data engineers to ensure reporting datasets are complete, reliable, and structured for analytical use.
* Document metric definitions, calculations, data sources, assumptions, and reporting dependencies.

Ownership and Stakeholder Communication

* Manage analytical assignments from requirement gathering through delivery and ongoing improvement.
* Communicate progress, dependencies, and issues proactively.
* Present findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Work independently while maintaining regular collaboration with US leadership and stakeholders.

**Essential Skills and Experience**

* **5+ years of relevant experience** in data analytics, business intelligence, or a similar role.
* **Direct, hands-on experience developing reports and dashboards in Omni**, including creating or modifying reporting logic and validating results.
* Strong SQL proficiency, including complex joins, CTEs, aggregations, window functions, and query troubleshooting.
* Experience delivering reporting solutions from business requirements through development, validation, and stakeholder review.
* Sound understanding of data modeling, relational databases, and data warehousing concepts.
* Demonstrated ability to investigate data issues and translate analytical findings into clear business insights.
* Strong attention to detail and accountability for the accuracy of reporting outputs.
* Clear communication skills and experience working directly with business stakeholders.
* Ability to prioritize work, manage competing requirements, and deliver with minimal supervision.
* Availability to collaborate with US counterparts during designated collaboration hours.

**Preferred Skills and Exposure**

* **Snowflake:** Experience querying warehouse data and working with datasets used for analytics and reporting.
* **Fivetran:** Familiarity with data ingestion pipelines, refresh schedules, and their impact on reporting availability and accuracy.
* **Medallion architecture:** Understanding of Bronze, Silver, and Gold data layers and how data progresses into business-ready reporting datasets.
* **Python:** Experience supporting data analysis, validation, or repetitive-task automation.
* **Git/GitHub:** Familiarity with version control for SQL, analytical code, or related documentation.
* Experience supporting SaaS products, financial services, or the automotive Finance & Insurance (F&I) industry.

**Educational Qualifications**

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Business Analytics, or a related discipline. Candidates with equivalent relevant professional experience will also be considered.

**What We Offer**

* Direct collaboration with US leadership and experienced data and product teams.
* Ownership of reporting solutions that support business and product decisions.
* Opportunity to work with modern analytics and cloud data platforms.
* Exposure to the automotive F&I industry and SaaS product environment.
* Scope to contribute to reporting standards, data quality, and analytical practices.

**Application Requirements**

Please highlight your **Omni development experience** in your application, including:

* The types of reports or dashboards you personally developed.
* Your responsibilities in writing queries, defining reporting logic, and validating results.
* The business requirements addressed and how the reports were used.

Candidates should be prepared to discuss a specific Omni reporting project and explain their individual contribution. Any examples shared must exclude confidential or proprietary information.

Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹70,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

We are seeking a data-driven CS Operations professional to lead retention and renewal operations and analytics within the Asia and Emerging Markets (AEM) Customer Success Operations team. In this role, you will own the operational and analytical frameworks that underpin renewal forecasting, churn risk identification, and revenue retention operations strategy. Reporting to the Director of CS Operations, you will serve as the analytical backbone for Customer Success Managers and leadership — including VP of Customer Success and CS Directors — translating complex customer data into clear, actionable intelligence that drives measurable retention outcomes.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* **Renewal Pipeline Analytics:** Own end-to-end analytics for the renewal pipeline — track renewal rates, ARR/ACV at risk, and on-time renewal performance across segments and regions; publish CS key metrics regularly.
* **Churn & Contraction Modelling:** Build and maintain predictive models to identify churn risk signals, contraction patterns, and at-risk cohorts; deliver proactive alerts to CS leadership and account teams.
* **Retention Performance Reporting:** Design and manage recurring retention dashboards and scorecards (weekly, monthly, QBR-level) surfacing retention metrics, win-back trends, and save-play effectiveness; leverage AI and automation tools to develop a programmatic approach for retention operations reporting.
* **Root Cause Analysis:** Lead post-churn or cancellation root cause analysis to identify systemic patterns; synthesise findings into actionable recommendations for Product, CS, and Commercial teams.
* **Renewal Process Optimisation:** Partner with CS and Finance to refine renewal workflows, escalation triggers, and SLA frameworks within tools like Gainsight and Salesforce.
* **Executive Storytelling:** Translate analytical findings into crisp executive narratives, supporting QBRs, exec-level reporting, and business reviews.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Work closely with Sales Ops, Finance, and Product to align retention KPIs with broader go-to-market objectives.

  

**Required Qualifications**

* 8–12 years of experience in Customer Success Operations, Revenue Operations, or a similar analytically focused role within a SaaS or subscription-based business.
* Proven expertise in renewal and retention operations and analytics, including Gross Retention Rate (GRR), Net Retention Rate (NRR), churn rate, logo retention, and ARR/ACV metrics.
* Advanced proficiency in Salesforce (SFDC) and Customer Success platforms such as Gainsight including experience building reports, dashboards, and customer lifecycle journeys.
* Expert-level proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including financial and data modelling, scenario analysis, and cohort/funnel analysis.
* Hands-on experience with BI tools (Tableau, Power BI, or equivalent) for self-service dashboard development and executive reporting.
* Strong statistical aptitude — comfortable with cohort analysis, funnel analysis, and basic predictive modelling techniques.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; ability to present data-driven narratives clearly and concisely to senior stakeholders.
* High attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
* Background in revenue accounting or finance, particularly for ARR reconciliation and SaaS metrics reporting.
* Exposure to Customer Success platforms such as Gainsight, Totango, ChurnZero, Planhat, or similar tools.
* Experience supporting or leading digital Customer Success or tech-touch retention programmes at scale.
* Hands-on experience with AI-powered analytics or automation solutions integrated within CS or CRM workflows.
* Demonstrated experience in stakeholder management across cross-functional teams including Finance, Sales, and Product.
Exposure to global or multi-regional SaaS operations with an understanding of India-based delivery and GTM models.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Working knowledge of SQL or Python for data extraction and analysis; comfort with large datasets and data validation.
Familiarity with machine learning or propensity modelling frameworks applied to churn prediction (e.g., logistic regression, gradient boosting).

**The application window is expected to close on:** 11/18/2026Job posting may be removed earlier if the position is filled or if a sufficient number of applications are received.Meet the Team
  
Cisco’s Global Supplier Management (GSM) organization is an industry-leading sourcing team in supply chain responsible for orchestrating direct material spend portfolio across strategic hardware commodities. Within GSM, the Cost Operations team operates as the central nervous system for enterprise hardware cost governance and quarterly cost roll-ups. We architect analytical models and digital quoting workflows that empower global commodity teams to make faster, data-driven decisions that optimize product margins and maintain supply resilience.
  
  
Your Impact
  
As a Business Analyst in GSM Cost Operations, you will be a key driver of commodity cost intelligence, quarterly quote cycle governance, and digital transformation. You will lead end-to-end quarterly RFQ quoting cycles, partner with Commodity Managers to structure complex component pricing strategies, and build advanced models that eliminate cost gaps and mitigate spend variances. In this role, you will champion the adoption of modern Generative AI, machine learning tools, and automated agent workflows to transform operational quoting into a predictive, autonomous capability. This position offers visibility, cross-functional leadership opportunities, and a platform to shape the future of digital supply chain operations at scale.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
**Lead Strategic Commodity Quoting& Cost Operations:** Orchestrate end-to-end quarterly and annual RFQ quoting cycles across assigned strategic hardware commodities. Govern quote intake, attribute drift analysis (MOQ, CT2R, COO, PSL, MPN lifecycle), and standard cost roll-ups in Oracle CG1 within strict fiscal timelines.
  
**Architect Advanced Analytics:** Build dynamic simulative cost models and QoQ variance bridge models. Track and quantify cost, spend, savings, providing executive-ready insights.
  
**Drive Cost Hole Governance& cost Variance Mitigation:** Identify cost holes, diagnose, and resolve missing component costs prior to quarter-end standard cost freezes. Oversee Purchase Price Variance (PPV) claim validations, supplier buydown liabilities, and Material Usage Variance (MUV) root-cause mitigation across manufacturing sites.
  
**GenAI& Digital Workflow Automation:** Implement Generative AI tools, LLM prompt engineering, and automated agent workflows. Streamline supplier follow-ups and ideate and execute automation of manual activities.
  
**Foster Cross-Functional Collaboration& Process Excellence:** Partner closely with Supply channel Leads (SCL), Hardware Engineering, Supply Chain Product Managers, Finance, and Contract Manufacturers to resolve operational bottlenecks, enforce master data integrity (Control Codes, Sourcing Rules), and mentor junior analysts.
  
  
Minimum Qualifications
  
**Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, Business Analytics, Finance, Operations Research, Economics, or a related quantitative field. (Master’s / MBA is a plus).
  
**Experience:** 6+ years of hands-on experience in hardware supply chain analytics, procurement cost engineering, direct material cost management, or financial operations within a high-tech or manufacturing environment.
  
**Advanced Excel Mastery:** Expert-level proficiency in Microsoft Excel for complex financial modeling, multi-tab data reconciliations, nested functions (INDEX-MATCH, XLOOKUP, dynamic arrays), and Power Query data transformations.
  
**Financial Acumen:** Strong financial acumen to evaluate the cost impact of non-material spend and correlate sourcing and manufacturing metrics to anticipate, identify, and communicate business and financial impacts.
  
**Business Intelligence& Data Modeling:** Proven experience designing, deploying, and maintaining enterprise analytical dashboards and data pipelines in Power BI or Tableau, with hands-on proficiency in SQL / Snowflake queries.
  
**Generative AI& Automation:** Demonstrated experience utilizing Generative AI tools, LLM prompt engineering, and basic scripting to optimize analytical workflows and business processes.
  
  
Preferred Qualifications
  
**Hardware Domain& Costing Mechanics:** Deep understanding of multi-tier hardware Bill of Materials (BOM) structures, component manufacturing cost drivers (wafer, assembly/test, packaging), and Non-Material Spend (PPV, Buydowns, MUV).
  
**Enterprise Systems Acumen:** Working knowledge of enterprise ERP, PLM, and sourcing platforms. Ability to navigate in complex process environments. Utilize analytical and data driven approach to identifying solutions and decision making.
  
**Executive Communication& Storytelling:** Outstanding ability to distill complex datasets into structured executive presentations
  
**Leadership& Problem-Solving Agility:** Strong analytical problem-solving acumen, self-driven initiative, cross-functional influencing skills, and a passion for mentoring junior team members and driving continuous operational innovation.
  
  
Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

jobs.description:
TransUnion's Job Applicant Privacy Notice

**Team Overview**

The Product TPM team operates at the intersection of business, technology, and delivery, enabling the successful development and rollout of scalable, customer-centric solutions. At the Consultant (P03) level, the team is composed of Technical Product Managers who own feature-level delivery while collaborating closely with engineering, design, and business stakeholders.
  
The team functions within an Agile framework, ensuring continuous delivery of high-quality product increments through iterative development, sprint cycles, and regular feedback loops. Each TPM is responsible for managing specific product modules or features, contributing to the broader product roadmap while aligning execution with organizational goals and customer needs.

This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week.  
  

**Role Overview And Core Responsibilities**

The Consultant (P03) – Technical Product Management (TPM) role is responsible for driving the end-to-end delivery of technology-enabled product features by effectively bridging business requirements with engineering execution. The role combines product ownership, technical understanding, and Agile delivery to ensure the development of scalable, high-quality solutions aligned with customer needs and organizational priorities.

At this level, the TPM owns feature-level execution, collaborates closely with cross-functional teams, and contributes to product strategy and roadmap under guidance from senior product leaders.
  
  
Role Overview And Core Responsibilities

**1. Product Ownership**

* Own and manage assigned product features or modules from concept to delivery
* Define detailed user stories, acceptance criteria, and maintain the product backlog
* Prioritize deliverables based on business value, customer impact, and feasibility

**2. Product Strategy & Roadmap Support**

* Contribute to product roadmap planning and execution
* Align feature development with overall product vision and business objectives
* Incorporate stakeholder input, user feedback, and analytics insights

**3. Technical Collaboration**

* Translate business requirements into clear technical specifications
* Work closely with engineering teams on solution design and implementation
* Assess technical trade-offs, dependencies, and constraints
* Ensure adherence to scalability, security, and performance standards

**4. Agile Delivery Execution**

* Actively participate in Agile ceremonies (sprint planning, grooming, stand-ups, retrospectives)
* Ensure timely and high-quality delivery of product increments
* Support continuous improvement in development and delivery processes

**5. Stakeholder Management**

* Collaborate with business, engineering, and UX/design teams
* Act as the primary point of contact for owned features
* Communicate progress, risks, and outcomes effectively

**6. Data-Driven Decision Making**

* Define and track KPIs for product features
* Use product analytics and user insights to drive improvements
* Optimize product performance, usability, and adoption

**7. Product Lifecycle Support**

* Support the full product lifecycle including requirement gathering, development, testing, and release
* Assist in documentation, training, and user adoption initiatives

Ensure smooth rollout and continuous enhancement of features

  

**Required Knowledge And Experiences**

The ideal candidate should have 5–8 years of experience in Technical Product Management, Product Management, or software/program delivery roles, with a strong understanding of the product lifecycle and Agile methodologies. They should possess solid knowledge of SDLC, ability to translate business requirements into technical specifications, and familiarity with tools like Jira and Confluence. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills are essential, along with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams. A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field is required, with Agile certifications (CSPO/CSM) considered an added advantage.

  

**TransUnion Overview:**

At TransUnion, we encourage and are committed to creating a real, positive impact and shared sense of purpose within our **Workforce for Good** , which empowers our people to grow, innovate and contribute to a better future for our communities and customers. We strive to build an environment where our associates are in the driver’s seat of their professional development— while having access to help along the way. We recognize that success comes when our associates thrive both professionally and personally; that’s why we prioritize work/life flexibility and offer resources for our teams across the globe to collaborate and drive excellence.

  

Be a part of our **Workforce for Good** – you’ll work with great people, pioneering products and cutting-edge technology.

**Company Description**

The Nemetschek Group is a leading global vertical software and AI provider driving the digital transformation of the AEC/O and media industries. With our deep domain expertise and intelligent, connected software solutions, we enable customers to turn data into real-time insights and smarter decisions throughout the entire lifecycle of buildings and infrastructure from ideation through planning, visualization, construction, operation, and renovation.  
Our AI-powered technologies and open standards approach boost productivity, collaboration, and sustainability for architects, engineers, contractors, building operators, and creative professionals. Over 7 million users worldwide rely on our customer-centric, human-led AI solutions. Founded by Professor Georg Nemetschek in 1963, today we employ over 4,000 experts globally across 14 subsidiaries.

 **Job Description**

What we are looking for

We are hiring a **Product Manager for SDS2** who combines strong product-management fundamentals with practical understanding of **structural steel fabrication, detailing, or manufacturing**. This is not intended to be a general-purpose software PM role.

The ideal candidate understands how engineering software fits into real fabrication workflows and has an **AI-first mindset**, actively looking for ways AI can improve detailing, automation, decision-making, user productivity, and the way we build products.

Industry & Technical Background

* Strong experience with **structural steel fabrication, steel detailing, manufacturing, or closely related industrial engineering workflows**
* Ability to communicate credibly with detailers, fabricators, engineers, developers, and customers
* Bachelor's degree in **engineering, architecture, or a closely related technical field**
* Understanding of complex engineering/manufacturing workflows and the ability to translate them into software requirements

Product Management

* Ideally **5+ years of Product Management / Product Ownership experience**, preferably with AEC, engineering, manufacturing, or technical B2B software
* Demonstrated ownership of:
  + Product vision and roadmap
  + Customer discovery and requirements
  + Epics and backlog prioritization
  + Agile product development
  + Product lifecycle
  + Market and competitive analysis
  + Product launches / GTM
  + Product metrics and business outcomes
* Strong project-management capability across distributed, cross-functional teams
* Excellent written, verbal, and customer-facing communication skills
* Comfortable working directly with Engineering, UX, Sales, Support, Marketing, customers, and senior leadership.
* **Jira** for requirements, epics, backlog, and Agile development

* Structural engineering knowledge

* Enterprise B2B software experience
* Data-driven product management

AI-First Mindset

We want someone who views **AI as a fundamental part of the future of SDS2**, not simply another feature.

Look for candidates who:

* Routinely use AI tools in their own work
* Understand practical applications of **AI/ML, copilots, agents, automation, or intelligent workflows**

* Can translate AI opportunities into customer problems, workflows, requirements, and measurable outcomes
* Are curious and willing to experiment rather than waiting for established industry solutions

Direct AI product experience is highly desirable but should **not outweigh steel-industry/domain knowledge**.

Strong Differentiators

Experience with one or more of the following should move a candidate **significantly higher in the recruiting funnel**:

===================

  

At Arctic Wolf, we’re on a mission to **end cyber risk** .

  

We are a global leader in security operations, helping organizations stay resilient against evolving cyber threats through industry-leading security operations, threat intelligence, and a people-first approach to cybersecurity.

  

More than 3,000 Pack members across the world work together every day to protect our customers and empower security teams with new levels of speed, accuracy, and intelligence at scale. What sets us apart is our relentless focus on our customers, innovation at scale, and a collaborative culture where talented people can do meaningful work that truly makes a difference.

  

We’re constantly looking for talented people to join the Pack and help us take our performance to the next level.

**About the Position:**
=======================

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to oversee our network appliance and fleet management infrastructure.

The Senior Product Manager: Network Appliance will contribute to our Product Management organization by leading the strategy, roadmap, and execution for the applications and capabilities we deploy and support on our network appliance platform as well as the infrastructure required to manage our fleet at scale.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Own the strategy and roadmap for the applications and capabilities deployed and supported on the platform.

* Drive Datapath capabilities, including IDS, syslog ingestion & pre-parsing, network ML.

* Own on premises features that bridge Arctic Wolf’s cloud to the customer environment via the network appliance platform.

* Own release management & device upgrades, including fleet rollout practices, containerized application delivery systems (e.g., Docker, ECR) as a reusable platform capability, and the over-the-air (OTA) upgrade experience.

* Own the base OS lifecycle for our Linux RTK OS – major version migration planning, patch cadence, and LTS/EOL policy, and the upgrade infrastructure for the existing fleet.

* Drive fleet management capabilities: dashboards, telemetry aggregation and analysis, and fleet-level configuration and feature-flag operations. Building product features to ensure the scalability and maintainability of our fleet.

* Own vulnerability and CVE patch management, including the field escalation feedback loop from Support & Security teams and engineering.

* Partner with Engineering Managers, Technical Leads, to translate strategic initiatives into executable engineering plans for a dedicated feature team.

* Partner with peer product managers to ensure network appliance platform capabilities support the deployment and monitoring of your roadmap initiatives.

* Collaborate with sales on new feature and configuration support.

Conduct competitive and technical research to inform roadmap decisions and differentiate our appliance services offering.

* 10+ years of prior product management experience, ideally in network security, cybersecurity, or appliance/edge software.

* Engineering or technical background, such as Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or Software Engineering.

* Experience with network detection/datapath technologies, API design, or licensing/entitlement systems.

* Experience with Jira, agile planning tools, and product analytics platforms.
Good To Have: Experience with intrusion detection systems, network traffic analysis, or deception technology.

============

  

All wolves receive compelling compensation and benefits packages, including:

  

* Equity for all employees
* 18 days annual leave, flexible holidays & festivals, and paid volunteer days
* Training and career development programs
* Comprehensive private benefits plan including medical insurance for you and your family, life insurance (3x compensation), and personal accident insurance.
A modern workplace in Helios Business Park in Bengaluru

=========================

At Arctic Wolf, protecting our people, customers, and data is fundamental to how we operate. All employees are expected to uphold our commitment to security, privacy, and compliance by following internal information security policies, standards, and controls designed to safeguard the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of business, customer, employee, and other confidential information and to support compliance with applicable legal and regulatory requirements.

Product Management in Meesho closely resembles our rocketship growth. Because we obsess over understanding customer behaviour, we’ve been able to carve out an e-commerce niche in Tier 2/3/4 towns in Bharat. Fun fact: Nearly 7% of India’s households shop with us. 😉
  
  
We are driven by a ‘user-first’ mindset. We have a strong bias for action. Above all, our team is driven by impact, not features. We drive ‘problem discovery’ & delivery - not only obsess over “what to build”, but execute with rigour to create impact.
  
  
But there’s more – we love to have fun as much as we love to work hard. From movie buffs to sportspersons, we have a super cool team. So, if a game of badminton after a day of brainstorming at work sounds like something you would love to do, then join us!

* Exceptional problem-solving skills based on first principles of thinking
* Good understanding of technology, and comfort with product management processes such as A/B experimentation, writing product requirement documents, managing product backlogs, and creating roadmaps

jobs.title: Product Manager (RASP)
jobs.description:
**About Bureau**

Bureau is a unified risk decisioning platform for Compliance, Fraud, and Transaction risks. Our platform is a single decision-making engine, powered by a 1 billion+ identity knowledge graph. Over 150 Banks, fintechs, retailers, and digital platforms use Bureau to verify identities faster and stop fraud earlier globally.

Bureau has raised $50M+ from renowned Silicon Valley and global investors including Sorenson Capital and PayPal Ventures and is expanding rapidly from APAC to Americas, Europe, and beyond.

**Why Bureau?**

Bureau is building the infrastructure that makes digital identities and transactions safe and trustworthy for billions of people. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is real.

We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, build systems from scratch, and care deeply about turning strategy into execution. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won't be your place. If you want to shape how a scaling global company operates—keep reading.

**About the Role: Product Manager - RASP**

You will own Bureau RASP (Runtime Application Self-Protection). It is a rare chance to take a category-defining security product from launch to scale.

* Sophisticated mobile fraud now executes inside the app itself. Bureau RASP answers with a four-layer Zero Trust framework embedded in the customer's app:
* Application integrity: code obfuscation, anti-tampering and anti-debugging, powered by XVM, our proprietary virtualization engine.
* Runtime and environment: detection of root, jailbreak, emulators, cloned apps, hooking and overlay attacks.
* Network and data channel: protection against MITM, packet sniffing, geo spoofing and VPN or proxy bypass.
* Visibility and policy: monitor, warn or block per threat from a dashboard, with immutable audit logs.

It is built at the OS level, goes live in minutes with no code changes, and feeds runtime signals into Bureau's Graph Identity Network. You will decide where it goes next.

**What you’ll be doing**

* Own the RASP vision, strategy and roadmap across Android and iOS.
* Track the mobile threat landscape and turn new attack patterns into shipped protections.
* Partner with security, SDK and platform engineers to deliver detections that are accurate, hard to bypass and light on app performance.
* Shape the customer experience: zero-code onboarding, the policy engine, alerts and audit reporting.
* Connect RASP signals with Device Intelligence, Behavioural Biometrics and the Graph Identity Network to create value no standalone RASP can match.
* Work with sales, solutions and marketing on positioning, pricing, demos and competitive wins.
* Spend time with CISOs, fraud heads and app teams at banks, fintechs and e-commerce firms to learn what they need.
* Define success metrics such as adoption, detection efficacy, false positives and integration time, and report on them.

**What You’ll Bring**

**Must have**

* 4-6 years in product management, with at least 2 years on a B2B security, fraud or mobile SDK product.
* Working knowledge of mobile app security: Android and iOS internals, reverse engineering, rooting, hooking and tampering.
* Comfort going deep with engineers on technical trade-offs, and going wide with customers on business outcomes.
* A record of taking a product from early release to enterprise adoption.
* Clear writing and sharp prioritisation.

**Good to have**

* Experience with RASP, app shielding, device fingerprinting or mobile threat defence.
* Exposure to BFSI or fintech customers and regulatory expectations for app security.
* An engineering or security research background.

**Our Culture**

* We hire self-motivated people and get out of their way
* We value performance, not hours worked
* Speed, ownership, and impact matter most

**Compensation**

* Competitive salary + potential equity
* Health benefits, flexible PTO, learning budget

At Mindtickle, we're helping companies create high-performing revenue teams, and we're looking for people who want to help shape what's next.

**Job Snapshot**
----------------

We are looking for a **Client Partner** who will serve as a strategic advisor and trusted long-term partner to Mindtickle's most important enterprise clients. This is not a traditional account management role; it sits at the intersection of management consulting, client engagement, and business transformation. You will own the end-to-end client relationship post-contract: driving value delivery, shaping how clients embed Mindtickle into their revenue strategy, and influencing C-suite stakeholders on long-term business outcomes. The ideal candidate brings a structured, hypothesis-driven approach to client problems, is comfortable operating at the executive level, and has a track record of driving measurable impact within complex, multi-stakeholder engagements.

This is a US Shift role. The timings can be from 4 pm - 1 am or 6:30 pm - 3:30 am IST.

### **What's in it for you?**

* Serve as the senior strategic advisor for a portfolio of enterprise clients, owning the relationship from contract signature through long-term value realisation.
* Diagnose client business challenges using structured frameworks, and design tailored engagement plans that connect Mindtickle's capabilities to measurable revenue outcomes.
* Lead executive-level conversations - QBRs, EBRs, and strategic planning sessions, with C-suite and senior VP stakeholders, presenting insights and influencing decision-making.
* Build and execute detailed client success plans with clear milestones, owners, and business impact metrics.
* Drive product adoption by understanding client workflows, identifying change management barriers, and designing programmes that embed Mindtickle into core sales processes.
* Proactively identify risks to client outcomes and renewals, developing and executing mitigation strategies before issues escalate.
* Identify and build the commercial case for expansion opportunities (cross-sell and upsell) grounded in demonstrated business value.
* Track and report on engagement health using metrics including ROI, MAU, GRR, NRR, and client health scores, and use data to drive prioritisation decisions.
* Serve as a structured voice of the client internally, working cross-functionally with Product, Professional Services, and Support to resolve issues and shape the roadmap.
* Contribute to the development of scalable engagement methodologies, playbooks, and best practices across the Client Partner team.

### **We’d love to hear from you, if you:**

* Have 1-3+ years of experience in management consulting, client engagement, or strategic advisory, ideally with direct experience delivering post-sale value to enterprise clients.
* Are skilled at structuring ambiguous client problems, developing clear recommendations, and driving implementation, not just advising from the sidelines.
* Have led complex, multi-stakeholder programmes and can manage competing priorities across a portfolio of large accounts simultaneously.
* Are confident presenting to and influencing C-level executives and senior business leaders, with the ability to adapt your communication style to the audience.
* Bring strong commercial acumen, you understand how enterprise businesses work, can build a credible ROI narrative, and know how to tie product value to board-level priorities.
* Are data-driven: comfortable building analyses, tracking business impact metrics, and using data to tell a compelling story.
* Have deep knowledge of SaaS business models, enterprise software ecosystems, and how technology-driven change gets adopted inside large organisations.
* Possess excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesise complex information into clear, actionable insights.
* Thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving environments and take ownership of outcomes rather than process.

### **Preferred Experience:**

* 1-3 years of total experience in a client-facing consulting or post-sale engagement role at a top-tier firm (e.g., MBB, Big 4, Tier-1 strategy boutique) or in an enterprise SaaS environment.
* Demonstrated track record of owning client outcomes end-to-end from diagnostic through delivery and commercial renewal.

At GSK, the Chief Patient Officer (CPO) organization is one of three strategic pillars of the company – the independent medical and scientific partner to R&D and Commercial. Medical’s vision is to embed the patient voice and external insights into product strategy and evidence generation, shape medical practice through trusted, non-promotional scientific engagement, and deliver measurable health impact for patients at scale.

This is your chance to build the enterprise AI Context Layer for GSK Medical – the trusted, connected foundation that turns data and content from across the medical planning framework into measurable value. As Associate Director Product Owner, Medical Data Products, you will own the data products and context layer spanning Data Generation, Scientific Communications, Medical Information, Publications and Channel Engagement, including Medical Science Liaison (MSL) interactions, non-personal channels, advisory boards and other external engagement activities.

**Champion the customer**

* Act as the voice of GMTs and LOCs through continuous user research, turning their pain points into an actionable, user-centric backlog.

**Define, validate and own success**

* Set success metrics up front, prove value through proofs of value (POVs) before scaling, and track key performance indicators (KPIs) such as adoption, data quality and user satisfaction.

**Evangelize and lead change**

* Lead change management, demos and training to drive enterprise-wide adoption and data literacy.

**Own architecture and canonical models**

* Oversee data ingestion end-to-end and the target canonical/conformed data model connecting engagement data to GSK Medical data – balancing technical debt against feature delivery.

**Establish governance by design**

* Oversee the data lake governance and framework – access models, schemas, classification, lineage, metadata, quality and storage standards aligned to CODE Orange – partnering with platform, security and data-owner teams and building GxP (regulated good-practice quality standards) and data protection in from the start.

**Hold partners to outcomes**

**Work AI-first**

* Use approved AI tools to accelerate discovery and backlog trade-offs – keeping AI in support of decisions, not replacing them.

**Future-proof the ecosystem**

**About Consilio**
Consilio is a global leader in eDiscovery, document review, legal talent, and consulting services, helping organizations navigate complex legal and business challenges.
  
  
**Job Summary:**
The Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW) Technical Product Owner is accountable for defining, prioritizing, and delivering EDW capabilities that create measurable value for internal clients and business stakeholders. This role establishes product direction, maintains a clear and actionable backlog, and serves as the primary decision-maker for scope and priority throughout the delivery lifecycle.
  
  
The Technical Product Owner partners closely with stakeholders, data engineers, developers, architects, project managers, and technical leads to translate strategic objectives and operational needs into product outcomes, user stories, acceptance criteria, and release plans. The role supports enterprise data solutions across relational databases, reporting platforms, ERP and CRM applications, middleware and iPaaS platforms, and proprietary systems. Success requires strong product judgment, technical fluency, stakeholder leadership, disciplined prioritization, clear communication, and the ability to make informed trade-offs among value, risk, effort, dependencies, and delivery timelines.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own the product vision, goals, roadmap, and delivery priorities for assigned data warehouse, reporting, and integration capabilities.

* Create, refine, prioritize, and maintain the product backlog, including epics, features, user stories, technical enablement work, defects, and operational improvements.
* Develop clear user stories and acceptance criteria that communicate business value, expected behavior, data requirements, and quality expectations.

* Accept or reject completed work based on agreed acceptance criteria and product quality expectations.
* Monitor production feedback, adoption, defects, support trends, and changing business needs to guide continuous product improvement.

* Maintain product documentation and provide release communication, knowledge transfer, and training support as needed.

* Demonstrated experience owning and prioritizing a product backlog and writing epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Working knowledge of Agile and Scrum practices, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews, and release planning.
* Experience working with relational databases such as Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, or equivalent platforms, including a practical understanding of SQL and data structures.
* Experience collaborating with technical teams delivering data warehouse, reporting, or data pipeline solutions.
* Experience using Jira or an equivalent product planning and work management platform.
* Strong stakeholder management, facilitation, negotiation, decision-making, and written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to understand technical concepts, evaluate delivery trade-offs, and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Experience defining product outcomes, acceptance measures, and release readiness.

**Preferred Experience:**

* Knowledge of enterprise data warehouse architecture, dimensional modeling, ETL or ELT patterns, data quality, metadata, and data governance.
* Experience with Microsoft SQL Server, SSIS, SSAS, Power BI, Python-based data pipelines, or comparable data engineering and analytics technologies.
* Experience with Salesforce, NetSuite, ServiceNow, SnapLogic, or similar enterprise applications and integration platforms.

jobs.title: Senior Product Owner, Workday HCM & Onboarding
jobs.description:
**Position Overview**
The
**Senior Product Owner**
is an experienced, functionally deep Workday professional who owns one or more Workday modules end-to-end on behalf of Revantage and its PortCos. This is not a passive coordination role — it is an active, hands-on domain mastery role. You are the subject-matter expert, the decision-maker, the stakeholder champion, and the product strategist for your assigned module(s). You will work across a complex multi-PortCo environment, running user forums, managing the release roadmap, driving adoption, and continuously finding ways to extract more value from the platform.
  
  
This role is specifically focused on Core HCM, Onboarding & Security. Additional module expertise is a plus. This role has a defined growth path: as the team matures, the Product Owner will take on line management responsibility for an Associate Product Owner, growing into a player-manager who both delivers and develops.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities
  
  
Domain Ownership & Functional Mastery**

* Own your assigned Workday module(s): Core HCM, Security and Onbaording end-to-end — from strategy and design through configuration, testing, deployment, and ongoing optimization.
* Develop and maintain deep functional expertise in your domain(s), staying current with Workday product updates, roadmap changes, and community best practices.
* Serve as the primary point of contact and escalation resource for your module area across all PortCos.
* Maintain comprehensive knowledge of how your module(s) interact with upstream and downstream systems and processes — and design solutions with those dependencies in mind.
* Think beyond Workday: identify complementary or supplementary technologies that could enhance capability in your domain — whether that is AI-powered tools, third-party integrations, or adjacent platforms.

**PortCo Engagement & Stakeholder Management**

* Build and maintain strong relationships with HR leaders, operations teams, and business stakeholders across multiple PortCos.
* Act as a trusted advisor — understanding each PortCo's unique workforce model, business context, and HR priorities.
* Run structured Product Owner forums, working groups, and user communities to surface requirements, share updates, and drive alignment.
* Manage competing priorities across PortCos with transparency — communicating trade-offs, timelines, and decisions clearly to all stakeholders.
* Facilitate requirements workshops and design sessions, translating business needs into clear, actionable Workday solutions.

**Roadmap & Release Ownership**

* Own and maintain the product roadmap for your module(s) — balancing strategic enhancements, PortCo-driven requirements, bug fixes, and Workday release adoption.
* Evaluate every Workday bi-annual release for impact and opportunity within your domain — leading opt-in decisions, testing, and rollout planning.
* Prioritize the backlog in collaboration with stakeholders, the Functional Architect, and People Technology leadership.
* Ensure all enhancements are delivered with appropriate change management, training, and communications to end users and HR teams.
* Track and report on the delivery and benefit realization of roadmap initiatives.

**Hands-On Delivery**

* Remain hands-on with Workday configuration in your module area — able to review, validate, and contribute to configuration work alongside the Associate Product Owner.
* Lead user acceptance testing (UAT) for enhancements and releases within your domain.
* Review and approve design documents, configuration specifications, and test plans before deployment.
* Support the Associate Product Owner(s) in day-to-day delivery, providing guidance, review, and quality oversight.

**Ecosystem & Innovation Thinking**

* Continuously evaluate the HR technology landscape for innovations relevant to your module area — e.g., AI in recruiting, manager effectiveness tools, payroll analytics.
* Propose and build the business case for technology enhancements or new tool adoption where Workday alone does not fully meet business needs.
* Collaborate with vendors (Workday, Paradox, HiredScore, Peakon, etc.) to stay ahead of product developments and advocate for Revantage's priorities.

**Team Development**

* In the near term, work closely with and provide functional guidance to the Associate Product Owner(s) aligned to your module area.
* As the team grows, take on formal line management responsibility for your Associate Product Owner — supporting their development, performance, and career growth.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of Workday functional experience with deep, hands-on expertise in at least two Workday modules.
* Demonstrated experience owning a Workday module in a production environment — including enhancements, releases, stakeholder management, and roadmap ownership.
* Experience working in a multi-entity, multi-PortCo, or shared-services HR technology model.
* Strong understanding of Workday business process configuration, security roles, reporting, and calculated fields.
* Proven ability to engage and influence senior HR stakeholders without direct authority.
* Experience running forums, steering committees, or user communities across a distributed stakeholder base.
* Global Workday implementation or support experience — able to navigate multi-jurisdiction complexity.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills — able to translate technical concepts for business audiences and vice versa.

**Module-specific Experience (by Role)**
Depending on the specific Product Owner role, candidates should bring deep expertise in one or more of the following clusters:
  
  

* Core HCM, Onboarding & Workday Help: Org design, job architecture, business process configuration, worker data, Workday Help case management.

Join us as we continue to lead in loyalty, delivering innovative customer experiences for some of the world’s most recognized brands while working alongside some of the best and brightest in loyalty.
  
  
**About The Team And What We’ll Build Together**
The Product Owner team makes Kobie's strategic product vision a reality through the development of technology solutions. We drive projects forward, collaborating with development teams and stakeholders to deliver unparalleled personalized experiences to customers worldwide. We are quick on our feet, using critical thinking and creative problem solving to optimize the value of products released. We champion platform standards to achieve long-lasting, quality outcomes that help our clients grow enterprise value through loyalty.
  
  
**How You Will Make An Impact**

* Lead design and execution of roadmap enhancements to Kobie Alchemy® Loyalty Cloud, owning the business logic and platform rules that drive loyalty program outcomes for enterprise clients.
* Translate complex business requirements into precise, unambiguous specifications that serve as the authoritative source of truth for automated and AI-assisted development workflows, while ensuring maximize reusability across clients and verticals.

* Owns and evolve the business logic governing your domains of expertise, serving as the voice of reason on what the platform should do and why, influencing technical and business decisions alike.
