jobs.title: Data Quality Analyst
jobs.description:
By clicking the “Apply” button, I understand that my employment application process with Takeda will commence and that the information I provide in my application will be processed in line with Takeda’s Privacy Notice and Terms of Use. I further attest that all information I submit in my employment application is true to the best of my knowledge.

**Job Description**
-------------------

  

* Work with Data Stewards across R&D and Global Medical to profile data, clarify requirements and document proposed quality rules, thresholds and severity for business approval.
* Develop, configure and maintain automated validations using SQL, Python and the approved data quality tools. Search the shared rule registry first and reuse or adapt approved rules where appropriate.
* Implement field-level, cross-system and business-process validations, as well as expected-versus-actual load and freshness validations. Ensure each validation produces dependable measurements (records evaluated, passed and failed, or expected and actual loads) and that failed records are easy for the business to understand.
* Test rules with pass/fail scenarios, then review the results with the Data Steward, refining the logic until the Data Steward confirms the results reflect the business intent. Prepare test evidence and obtain the required business approval before the platform team releases a rule; a rule is complete when it is approved and launched into production.
* Monitor data quality results over time, maintain scorecards and reporting, then support regular reviews with business owners and Stewards. Use these reviews to identify recurring data issues and recommend tuning rules, adjusting thresholds, or retiring rules that no longer add value.
* Support data remediation by investigating validation rule and monitoring failures. Help Data Stewards decide whether the cause is the rule, the source data or the data flow; route issues to the responsible team; and confirm fixes through re-testing.
* Manage new rules, changes, enhancements and retirements through an agreed intake process and work queue. Maintain specifications, test evidence, approval references and change history, raise blockers early and coordinate production handoffs with DD&T and the platform teams.
* Maintain the team's data quality playbook, including reusable rule patterns, templates, and testing and documentation standards, so new datasets, systems and business groups are onboarded the same way each time.
* Train and mentor new analysts and other team members on the tools, standards and ways of working, and review their rules and test evidence. Help Data Stewards learn how to request rules, read the results and act on them.
* Contribute to the evaluation and adoption of data quality tools, platforms and methods, including automation and AI-assisted rule development, and help move rules and evidence when tools or platforms change.

**Accountability and Decision Rights**

The Data Quality Analyst is responsible for the quality of the technical rules, tests, documentation and results within their assigned work and, when reviewing the work of others, for applying the team's standards including solutioning and implementation of validations within the pipeline. This requires an understanding of the architecture and technology stack within Takeda. Data Stewards and Trustees retain responsibility for business definitions, thresholds, risk decisions and approvals. DD&T and the designated platform teams own production deployment and platform operations; source and technical owners remain responsible for correcting defects in their systems. The R&D Data Governance lead sets priorities and resolves escalations.

**Education**

* Minimum: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Statistics or a related field.
* Preferred: Master’s degree in a related field.

**Experience**

* Minimum: 8+ years in data quality, data engineering or technical data analysis.
* Hands-on experience with at least one enterprise data quality, data integration or business rules tool (such as Informatica), and the ability to learn new tools as the platform changes.
* Experience in data profiling, reconciliation, automated validation, testing and investigation of data quality issues.

**Skills**

Required

* Solid understanding of data quality dimensions (such as completeness, accuracy, validity, consistency and timeliness) and how to measure them.
* Strong SQL and working knowledge of Python or a comparable scripting language.
* Ability to translate business requirements into technical rules and explain methods, standards and findings clearly to nontechnical stakeholders and new team members.
* Sound troubleshooting, documentation, collaboration and work-prioritization skills.
* Willingness to coach others, share knowledge and review colleagues' work constructively.

Desirable

* Experience with cloud data platforms (such as Databricks and Spark), work-management tools (such as ServiceNow) and reporting tools (such as Power BI).
* Experience with pharmaceutical, clinical or GxP-related data and applicable quality requirements.
* Experience training, mentoring or leading the work of other analysts.
* Familiarity with automation or AI-assisted approaches to data quality.

IND - Bengaluru

Employee

Amadeus is an equal opportunity employer and committed to an accessible recruitment process. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age, beliefs, disability or any other characteristics protected by law.

This position is based at our on-site office in Bengaluru. Lowe's offers an ultramodern work environment, complete with cutting-edge technology, collaborative workspaces, an on-site gym and clinic, and other perks to enhance your work experience.

Lowe’s is a FORTUNE® 100 home improvement company serving approximately 16 million customer transactions a week in the United States. With total fiscal year 2024 sales of more than $83 billion, Lowe’s operates over 1,700 home improvement stores and employs approximately 300,000 associates. Based in Mooresville, N.C., Lowe’s supports the communities it serves through programs focused on creating safe, affordable housing, improving community spaces, helping to develop the next generation of skilled trade experts and providing disaster relief to communities in need. For more information, visit Lowes.com.

  
  

**About Lowe’s India**

Lowe’s India, the Global Capability Center of Lowe’s Companies Inc., is a hub for driving our technology, business, analytics, and shared services strategy. Based in Bengaluru with over 4,500 associates, it powers innovations across omnichannel retail, AI/ML, enterprise architecture, supply chain, and customer experience. From supporting and launching homegrown solutions to fostering innovation through its Catalyze platform, Lowe’s India plays a pivotal role in transforming home improvement retail while upholding strong commitment to social impact and sustainability. For more information, visit Lowes India.

The Merchandising Service Team supports Lowe’s in maintaining the “Big Three” in-store priorities: cleanliness, full stock, and proper service. The team drives merchandising execution by aligning operational workflows, capacity planning, reset prioritization, audit readiness, and SOP governance across business partners and store teams.

MST acts as a key liaison between Project Planning, field teams, and cross-functional stakeholders by providing data-driven insights, process standards, and execution support to improve decision-making and reduce operational friction. The team focuses on improving communication, labor-hour accuracy, planning efficiency, and service quality through structured analysis, performance tracking, root-cause identification, and continuous process improvement.

  

MST ensures merchandising strategies are executed with consistency, accuracy, and speed while supporting store productivity, audit compliance, and a high-quality customer experience.

  
  

**Job Summary:**

The Senior Analyst supports MST operations by owning complex workflows, analyzing performance trends, and driving process improvements across Reset, Service, audit, and planning activities. This role partners with MST, Project Planning, and cross-functional stakeholders to identify operational gaps, improve labor-hour accuracy, reduce communication touchpoints, and streamline planning processes.

  

The Senior Analyst is expected to lead root-cause analysis, maintain governance standards, develop reporting insights, and guide analysts in improving execution quality, consistency, and productivity

  
  

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

**Core Responsibilities:**

* Own complex MST workflows end-to-end and ensure timely, accurate execution across all MST Functions.
* Analyze labor hours, workload trends, audit results, and operational performance to identify risks and opportunities.
* Lead root-cause analysis for recurring issues, process gaps, and execution delays.

* Maintain and improve SOPs, knowledge repositories, templates, and governance documentation.
* Build and review trackers, leverage dashboards, and reports to support data-driven decisions.
* Support audit readiness for Reset and Service processes and ensure compliance with operational standards.
* Mentor Analysts and Associate Analysts by sharing process knowledge, reviewing outputs, and supporting capability building.

**Years of Experience**

* 4+ Years
  

  

**Education Qualification & Certifications (optional)**

**Required Minimum Qualifications**:

* Bachelor’s Degree
  

  

**Skill Set Required**

**Primary Skills (must have)**  
**Key Skills:** Data Literacy & Data Interpretation, Advanced Excel, Retail Domain Experience, Business Analysis & Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Stakeholder Management and Strong Communication & Articulation Skills.

  
  

* Strong Communication Skills, Attention to Detail

jobs.title: Lead Data Analyst
jobs.description:
**About us:**

Working at Target means helping all families discover the joy of everyday life.

  

**About Target**

As a Fortune 50 company with more than 400,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers. Joining Target means promoting a culture of mutual care and respect and striving to make the most meaningful and positive impact.

At Target, we have a timeless purpose and a proven strategy. Some of the best minds from different backgrounds come together to redefine retail in an inclusive learning environment that values people and delivers world-class outcomes. Target in India operates as a fully integrated part of Target's global team and supports the company's global strategy and operations.

**About the team**

The IT Data Platform (ITDP) team enables data-driven management of Target's technology ecosystem by bringing together trusted data and insights across technology assets, software delivery, infrastructure, reliability, security, engineering effectiveness, and technology operations. The Analytics team within ITDP transforms this data into metrics, analytical products, dashboards, predictive insights, and decision-support capabilities that help technology teams understand what is happening, why it is happening, where risk may be emerging, and where action is needed. The team is building towards an analytics capability that progresses from descriptive and diagnostic analytics to predictive and prescriptive insights, using statistical methods, applied data science, and GenAI where each approach is appropriate.

**As a Lead Data Analyst for Target's IT Data Platform Analytics team you'll:**

Support Target Technology leadership with critical data analysis and intelligence that enables faster, smarter and more scalable decision-making across the technology ecosystem. Collaborate with senior stakeholders to understand priorities and roadmap, frame ambiguous problems, and turn technology data into analytical products, predictive capabilities, and AI-enabled solutions that achieve measurable outcomes.

* Demonstrated thought leadership in the application of data, analytics, data science, and AI to complex technology problems.
* Ability to work independently and with senior technology leaders to turn ambiguous problems into clear analytical questions, measurement frameworks, data solutions, models, and decision capabilities.
* Understand and articulate interfaces with Target Technology representatives, Product Managers, engineers, and other stakeholders to validate analytical requirements and present final results.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to collect, organize, analyze, and disseminate significant amounts of information with attention to detail, accuracy, and sound analytical judgment.
* Consult, design, develop, and deliver analytical solutions and AI (GenAI, Agent, Agentic) resulting in decision support, predictive insights, risk models, or reusable analytical capabilities.
* Expert in working with large-scale datasets using tools such as GCP BigQuery, Spark, or SQL-based warehouses and data pipelines using Airflow or similar tools.
* Practical experience to evaluate and monitor AI-driven analytical workflows, including defining quality metrics such as accuracy and relevance, assessing reliability, measuring business impact, and establishing appropriate evaluation practices.
* Lead the development and evolution of analytical frameworks such as Change Risk Score, predictive alerting, technology health signals, and other proactive intelligence capabilities, including methodology, validation, monitoring, and adoption.
* Connect signals across software delivery, applications, infrastructure, incidents, reliability, security, ownership, dependencies, and other technology domains to discover patterns and drivers that are not visible through isolated metrics.
* Develop expertise in technology domain context and cultivate trusted relationships with technology and product leaders; be a strong storyteller using data to influence decisions.
* Contribute to and establish the right artifacts to document AI solutions, analytical methodologies, model assumptions, evaluation approaches, and responsible-use considerations used in analytical projects.
* Contribute to knowledge-sharing systems, mentor analysts, and raise analytical standards through reusable methods, reviews, learning forums, and iterative model-building practices.
* Ensure compliance with corporate data protection standards and establish responsible AI practices, including data privacy, bias mitigation, explainability, governance, and appropriate risk considerations for analytical and AI-driven solutions.
* Keep up to date on technology analytics, applied data science, GenAI, agentic AI, and emerging methodologies, and identify high-value opportunities to apply them across ITDP.

**About You**

Experience: Overall 8-12 years exp and relevant 6-8 years exp

Qualification: B.Tech / B.E. or Masters in Statistics /Econometrics/Mathematics equivalent

* Adept at Structured Query Language (SQL), SQL optimization, data warehousing, and DW/BI concepts.
* Proficient in BI visualization tools (i.e. Looker, Power BI, Tableau) with ability to learn additional vendor and proprietary visualization tools.
* Expert in structured and unstructured data environments with proven hands-on work with large, complex datasets and multiple data sources.
* Hands-on experience in R, Python, or other open-source languages and analytical environments.
* Technical proficiency in analytical techniques such as Regression, Time-series models, Classification, Forecasting, Anomaly Detection, and similar methods to discover and measure key technology drivers and risks.
* Ability to evaluate statistical and machine-learning approaches, assess model performance and calibration, understand uncertainty and limitations, and translate models into actionable decision capabilities.
